title: Automated HA with Patroni & repmgr
description: Deploy production-grade automated failover using Patroni, etcd, and HAProxy for true 99.999% database uptime.

data.text: **Patroni** is the industry-standard template for building high-availability PostgreSQL clusters. It coordinates node state via a Distributed Consensus Store (DCS) like **etcd** and automatically manages primary election, streaming replication, and failover.

data.caption: Patroni HA Cluster with etcd and HAProxy
data.definition:
flowchart TD
    Client[Application Client] --> HAProxy[HAProxy / Load Balancer]
    HAProxy -->|Port 5000: Write Pool| Primary[PostgreSQL Primary]
    HAProxy -->|Port 5001: Read Pool| Standby[PostgreSQL Standby]
    Primary <--> DCS[etcd 3-Node Cluster: Leader Election]
    Standby <--> DCS
    Primary -->|Streaming Replication| Standby

data.text: Patroni is not a daemon that replaces PostgreSQL; it manages a standard PostgreSQL instance through its configuration API. It holds a leader key in etcd, and only the node holding that key runs as primary. HAProxy reads Patroni's health endpoints to route the write pool to whichever node is currently primary.

data.title: A minimal Patroni configuration
data.content: The DCS section points at etcd, and the bootstrap section defines the initial primary and the replication user. Patroni replaces the generated config on start.
data.code:
scope: postgres
namespace: /db/
name: pg1

restapi:
  listen: 0.0.0.0:8008
  connect_address: pg1:8008

etcd3:
  hosts: etcd1:2379,etcd2:2379,etcd3:2379

bootstrap:
  dcs:
    ttl: 30
    loop_wait: 10
    retry_timeout: 10
    maximum_lag_on_failover: 1048576
  initdb:
    - encoding: UTF8
    - data-checksums

postgresql:
  listen: 0.0.0.0:5432
  connect_address: pg1:5432
  data_dir: /data/patroni
  authentication:
    replication:
      username: replicator
      password: replpass
    superuser:
      username: postgres
      password: postgres

  parameters:
    wal_level: replica
    max_wal_senders: 10
    hot_standby: 'on'

  pg_hba:
    - host replication replicator 0.0.0.0/0 scram-sha-256
    - host all all 0.0.0.0/0 scram-sha-256

data.title: Interview angle: HA is consensus plus routing
data.text: A complete HA answer has three layers: the data layer (streaming or synchronous replication), the control layer (a consensus store that guarantees a single primary), and the connection layer (HAProxy or a service that routes to the current primary). Patroni and repmgr implement the control layer; they do not remove the need to size the consensus cluster with an odd number of nodes, test failover regularly, and fence a partitioned primary.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Patroni uses etcd leader leases to ensure only one primary exists at any moment.
Healthcheck endpoints (`/primary`, `/replica`) allow HAProxy to route read/write traffic automatically.
The industry benchmark for self-hosted enterprise PostgreSQL high availability.
